title: Chemical Formulas and Compound Composition
requiredLabVisualSimulationEvidence: Formula interpretation and composition analysis using formula tables. No chemical handling is required.
simulationVirtualLabReviewRequirement: Required for bonding models, molecular geometry, ionic/covalent comparisons, and intermolecular forces
directSimulationStudentTask: After the simulation opens, use the molecule-building workspace. Use the available atom kit to build the molecule or formula named in the lesson activity. Count each element in the completed model and compare the count to the written chemical formula. Record the formula, element counts, model evidence, and any naming or formula rule used in Chemical Formulas and Compound Composition.
